Multishot II Ricochet I Considered Casting
* Ice Nova: Is no longer able to originate from Frostbolt while cascading sideways.
- Frostbolt: Now has 120-195% more Magnitude of Chill inflicted at Gem levels 5-20. No longer has Chills Enemies as though dealing more damage.

- Cold Snap: Has been reworked, and renamed to Snap. It can now be used on any frozen, shocked or ignited enemy or on a Frostbolt, causing an explosion of the corresponding damage type and creating a remnant of the corresponding type from enemies. This explosion can chain react to a limited extent from enemies hit that are affected by the same ailment. Now deals 48-540 to 72-810 Cold Damage, 2-27 to 46-512 Lightning Damage, or 17-192 to 26-288 Fire Damage at Gem levels 5–20 (previously 70-670 to 105-1005 Cold Damage). Quality now grants 0-10% chance to spawn an additional remnant (previously 0-20% chance to not consume freeze). Cold Explosion now deals 50% more Damage against Unique Enemies. Now has a 4 second Cooldown. - Frostbolt: Now has a minimum level of 5. Base Projectile Speed has been lowered by 20%. No longer leaves Chilled Ground as it travels. Instead, it Chills as though dealing 120-195%% more Damage at Gem levels 5-20. Projectile now deals 15-23 Cold Damage at Gem level 5 (previously 24-36), scaling up to 144-216 Cold Damage at Gem level 20 (previously 201-302).
